title: The graded-overlap bullet's failed-agent counts have no benchmark row and say 1 of 4 isolated full-overlap runs where the records show 3
goal: The graded-overlap reading in kb/_self/token-efficiency.md gives failed-agent counts a reader can recompute from kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv (a per-run metric, or the counts dropped), and names its 110 USD total as the cost metric beside its rule that USD figures are the usd metric. Found by the SP-n7f53pgv review (S2 and S3 on ST-fdigz7xe); the shared-against-isolated verdict holds when recomputed.

run:
import csv,re,sys,collections
T=collections.defaultdict(dict)
for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv')):
    if r['scenario']=='multi' and r['date']>='2026-10-26' and r['case']=='research' and 'coord=isolated' in r['arm'] and 'delta' not in r['arm'] and re.fullmatch(r'research-\d+/(turns|facts_verified)',r['metric']):
        T[r['record']][r['metric']]=float(r['value'])
bad=sum(1 for m in T.values() if any(m.get('research-%d/turns'%i,0)>150 and m.get('research-%d/facts_verified'%i,1)==0 for i in (1,2,3)))
line=open('kb/_self/token-efficiency.md').read().split('\n')[152]
said=[int(x) for x in re.findall(r'(\d+) of 4 isolated runs had an agent fail',line)]
print('records',len(T),'csv failed',bad,'doc says',said);sys.exit(0 if said and said[-1]==bad else 1)

repro_reason: the defect is a doc figure against committed benchmark rows; no tool computes the failure count
